when_false: Set to false if the patient has undergone abdominal imaging now and the imaging does not show characteristic findings of acute pancreatitis, or if the patient has not undergone abdominal imaging now.

name: patient_meets_diagnosis_criteria_for_acute_pancreatitis_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient meets the diagnostic criteria for acute pancreatitis as specified in the requirement.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has abdominal pain consistent with acute pancreatitis now AND (serum lipase > 3x ULN OR characteristic findings on abdominal imaging).
when_false: Set to false if the patient does not meet both the pain criterion and at least one of the two additional criteria.
